translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Kkepas we Efang Menaw
Noan oatowe pweoneotaen faeinaengiy nge Kkepas we a fasiun no; Kkepas we eno reen Deus, nge Kkepas we ina iiy Deus.
Saengi rhag ne pweoneotaen nge Kkepas we a no reen Deus.
Oanongaen meeta Deus a feeori nge e itto me reen; esooar eew aegiaeg ne ese ffeeor me reen.
Iiy Kkepas eei minne efang menaw, nge iiy menaw eei minne e aesseremaar aeremas.
Iiy seram we e aesserema roorh, nge roorh ese oarorha seram.
Deus a fang naiun rhooan pweipwogin kkepas, erhai mwaaen itan John,
iwe a itto pwe epwe aengaeniir aeremas wunuunun seram we, pwe oanongeer rhooakka repwe rongorong kkepas we nge repwe niugiuniug.
Iiy wooan oanongan saapw iiy seram we; iiy e itto pwe epwe itto aepesa kkepesaen seram we.
Ieei minne oanongonniuwan seram, seram we epwe itto noan faeinaengiy pwe epwe ttin tiw wooar oanongeer aeremas.
Kkepas we a no wooan faeinaengiy, iwe inamwo iga Deus efeeori faeinaengiy me reen, nge faeinaengiy ese giuneei.
Iiy e itto wooan sipegin faniuwan, nge sipegin aeremesaen faniuwan rese aetiwa.
Aekkaaemweoi re aetiwa nge re niugiuniug ngaeni; iwe ikkeei a aeitaar pwe iir naiun Deus.
Rese no pwe naiun Deus reen aar wupwutiw, nge saapw tipaen aeremas ngaere tipaen erhai mwaaen, pwe faer saengi tipaen Deus.
Iiy Kkepas we a itto no noa pwe aeremas, iwe a itto nonno neeirh, nge a sseog noa reen ffayeo me min nnet. Sa weri nningan, nning we mwaaen we Seman e ngaenneei pwe iga iiy rhag Naiun.
Iiy John e aepesa wunuunun. Aan aekkepwas aegini pwe, “Ieen iiy mwaaen we i aekkaepesa pwe, ‘Iiy epwe itto mwiriy, nge iiy e taegias me mmwaei, pwe iya fasiun no me weni mmwaen aaei supw.’ ”
Me reen temoagon ffayeo na aan a aewenepwuwagirh faaen fiteig oanongarh, a aewenepwuwagirh noa rhag.
Deus a fang oasoapwosoapw kkewe ngaeni Moses, nge faayeow me nnet e itto me reen Jesus Kristus.
Esaaen yor mwo faaen eew ne erhai a weri Deus. Pwe mwaaen na rhag Naiun, ina iiy rhag Deus, nge eno rhag wenepeigin minna Seman, nge iiy minne a giuneei noa wunuunun.
Aaen John Baptist Fenai
Soamwoonin Jews me noan Jerusalem ra aefengaar noa aaemweoi patere me Levites repwe noa aeiineow John pwe, “Een iyo?”
John ese oapa iiy iyo pwe a faer aeffeta noa nge a iura pwe, “Saapw ngaang Kristus.”
Iwe ra aeiineow pwe, “Iwe nge een iyo? Een Elijah?” John a iura pwe, “Aapw, saapw ngaang.” Nge ra pwan aeiineow pwe, “Een Profeta we?” Nge iiy a pwan paniuwaeniir pwe, “Aapw.”
Nge ra aengaeni pwe, “Iwe aengaenigemaem ngaere een iyo. Pwe aeipwe noa aengaeniir mwaaen kkewe refangeto aemaem. Meeta wopwe iura reen mmwenemw?”
Aessefaaenin kkepas we aaen John a aepesa miniwe mwaeniaen profeta we Isaiah:

content.text: “Ngaang ‘aeremas we i iyaekkepwas me noan desert pwe:

content: Rhooan pweipwogin kkepas kkewe Pharisees re aefengaar,
ra aeiineow John pwe, “Ngaere saapw een Kristus, ngaere Elijah, ngaere Profeta we, iwe meeta faan wonoa paptismus aeremas reen?”
John a paniuwaeniir, “Ngaang i paptismus reen rhan, nge e iu erhai me neeimi nge oawse giuneei.
Ina aeremas na epwe itto me mwiriy, nge ngaang ese fin ipwe pwaeisi geeogeeon nokkaan.”
Oanongaen minikkeei nge ewen me Bethany ina eno peig na eotiw me reen pwupwu we Jordan, peig we John e paptismus fetaen ee.
Sheep we Naiun Deus
Sorotaen raaenin we eraaen nge John a weri Jesus pwe a ikkitto, nge a iura pwe, “Inaan iiy Sheep we Naiun Deus, iwe e arhiuwa noa monofitin faeinaengiy!
Een iiy mwaaen we igaen aepesa mmwenen iwe i iura pwe, ‘Erhai mwaaen ina epwe itto mwiriy, nge iiy e taegias me mmwaei, pwe iya fasiun no me weni mmwaen aaei supw.’
Ngaang ise giuneei aere epwe iiy iyo, nge ngaang iya itto nge iya itto paptismus reen rhaan pwe epwe pwae ngaeniir re Israel ngaere iiy iyo.”
Iwe John a pwaeritae pwe, “Ngaang iweri Espritu Santus e ittiw me noan naaeng nge eweei erhai dove iwe a ittiw no noa wooan.

Ngaang ise giuneei aere epwe iiy iyo, nge Deus, iwe efangeto ngaang pwe ipwe ittiw paptismus reen rhaan, nge a aengaeniaei pwe, ‘Wopwe weri Espritu Santus aan ittiw no wooan erhai mwaaen; iiy mwaaen we epwe paptismus reen Espritu Santus.’ ”
John a iura pwe, “Iya weri, iya aengaenigaemi pwe iiy minne Naiun Deus.”
Rhooawe Mmwaen Naiun Jesus Rhooan Kkayeo
Mmasetae nge John me riiurhai rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra pwan itto iu igiwe,
nge a weri aaen Jesus faaeraeg noa. A iura pwe, “Een iiy Sheep we Naiun Deus.”
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe riiurhai re rongorong miniwe e aepesa nge ra ttapw noa mwirin Jesus.
Jesus enoa toagun, a weri aar tapweto me mwirin, iwe a aeiineeor pwe, “Meeta oaw kiukkiutta?” Ra paniuwaeni, “Wo nonno iya Rabbi?” (Wewen nge “Sinsei”.)
Nge iya iura pwe, “Oaw itto oawpwe noa weri.” (Epwene aerepaen faawu konook nee oatofaaef.) Ra tapweei noa ra noa weri igiwe eno nonno ee, iwe ra nonoa reen noan raaenin we.
Erhai mwaaen kkewe nge itan Andrew, iwe pwiin Simon Peter.
Enoa rhag noa giutta mwaaen pwiin Simon, nge a aengaeni pwe, “Aeiya rhuungi Messiah.” (Wewen nge “Kristus”).
Iwe ra pwigi noa Simon reen Jesus. Jesus a fan ngaeni nge a iura pwe, “Een Simon we naiun John, wopwene itaeni Cephas.” (Iteei nge e aeffitaeg ngaeni rhag Peter, wewen nge “faai.”)
Jesus a Faingiir Philip me Nathanael
Mmasetae nge Jesus a maengiy epwene noa Galilee. Enoa nge a rhuungi Philip nge a aengaeni pwe, “Itto tapweaei!” (
Philip nge re Bethsaida, aepinoamw we Andrew me Peter re nonno ee.)

Philip a noa weri Nathanael nge a aengaeni pwe, “Aeiya weri mwaaen we Moses e foatogi wunuunun noa pwapwioron anniug we nge iwe profeta kkewe repwan foatogi wunuunun. Iiy Jesus we naiun Joseph, iwe saengi Nazareth.”
Nathanael a aeiineo pwe, “Yor min mwamwaai ne epwe itto me Nazareth?” Philip a iura pwe, “Itto pwe wopwe noa weri!”
Igiwe Jesus a weri aaen Nathanael aan ikkito a fioangei wunuunun pwe, “Ieen iiy erhai oanongonniuwaen re Israel; esooar eew min oatupwutupw ne eno wooan!”
Nathanael a aeiineow pwe, “E ifa wusun nge wa giuneaei?” Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Ngaang i weriug pwe womooat faaen waniwan we fig, weni mmwaen aaen Philip faingiug.”
Nathanael a iura pwe, “Sinsei, een minne Naiun Deus! Een minne Kingaen Israel!”
Jesus a iura pwe, “Oamw rhag niugiuniug iga i aengaeniug pwe i weriug igiwe wono faaen fig we? Eyor aaemweoi minikka wopwe naaen itto weri ikka e taegias saengi minneei!”
Nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi minna wenewenen: oawpwe weri aan susu noa naaeng nge oawwa weriir angkenus kkewe Naiun Deus aar ittae me ittiw wooan mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas.”
